Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.ftpclient.net

Class RemoteEntry

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.ftpclient.net.RemoteEntry
public final class RemoteEntry extends Object
One entry in a remote directory listing: the protocol-neutral view the UI and the transfer logic work with, whether it came from an FTP LIST/MLSD or an SFTP ChannelSftp.ls.

Instances are immutable value objects. getModifiedMillis() and getSize() may be 0 / -1 when the server did not report them, so callers must treat those as "unknown" rather than "empty".

  • Constructor Details

    • RemoteEntry

      public RemoteEntry(String name, long size, long modifiedMillis, boolean directory, String permissions, String linkTarget)
      Creates a listing entry.
      Parameters:
      name - the entry's base name (never the full path)
      size - the file size in bytes, or UNKNOWN_SIZE
      modifiedMillis - the last-modified time in epoch millis, or 0
      directory - true for a directory (or a symlink to one)
      permissions - a permission string such as rwxr-xr-x, or ""
      linkTarget - the symlink target, or null when not a link
